pages.text: The $(d)Scraper$() is used to get $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/organic_matter)Organic Matter$(/l) from mobs.$(br2)Right-click a mob to scrape it, or sneak and right-click empty air to scrape yourself. Scraping damages and may anger the target.
Scrapers can be enchanted with $(9)Delicate Touch$(), which prevents damaging and angering entities.
